exposure: Surgical treatment for heterotopic fallopian tubal pregnancy (HP-tube)
Surgical treatment for heterotopic interstitial pregnancy (HIP)
cohort: The study included patients diagnosed with heterotopic fallopian tubal pregnancy (HP-tube) or heterotopic interstitial pregnancy (HIP) who received surgical treatment at the study hospital from January 2005 to December 2020.
finding: Patients with heterotopic fallopian tubal pregnancy (HP-tube) and heterotopic interstitial pregnancy (HIP) achieved comparable intrauterine pregnancy outcomes after early diagnosis and treatment, and laparoscopic and open surgical approaches for HIPs also yielded similar pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Laparoscopic treatment for HIPs resulted in similar caesarean section rates compared to laparotomy.
